task: Prevent all official validations in one git workspace from running simultaneously and invalidating wall-clock proof gates.
outcome: When a second lattice validate or done_required_validate starts, its terminal prints "waiting for workspace validation capacity" with holder and heartbeat details; after the first finishes it starts automatically, and both commands produce their own normal result or evidence.
facts: Existing validationExecutionLockPath is canonical across linked worktrees but ends in <storyId>.lock, so only same-story execution is serialized.
Verifier has three story-aware wrapper call sites and done_required_validate already uses withValidationExecutionLock, but no-story lattice validate bypasses that lock entirely.
An observed competing official node bin/lattice.js validate process had no story argument, so a story-only outer wrapper would leave the real contention path unfixed.
The existing per-story lock is fail-fast, has 2-second heartbeat, 120-second stale classification, pid/process-start checks, stale reclaim, and AsyncLocalStorage reentrancy.
B-a7c5 and B-9ff1 validations ran simultaneously for 20-30 minutes; system load exceeded 40 and unrelated members timed out at unchanged 120/180/300-second gates.
Bottom-level acquireMkdirLock supports holder metadata, stale classifiers, ownership-checked release, and deadlines, but its synchronous wait would block same-process heartbeat timers.
Product review requires asynchronous wait-and-run with periodic holder/heartbeat diagnostics, not fail-fast contention.
Bare npm test bypasses official Lattice handlers and is explicitly outside this Story.
constraints: Keep the existing per-story evidence lock and acquire workspace capacity before it in fixed global→story order.
Use git-common-dir shared root so main and linked worktrees contend on one workspace lease.
Wrap lattice validate regardless of whether a story ID is supplied.
Wait asynchronously so heartbeat and abort timers remain live; do not use synchronous polling that blocks the holder context.
Honor abort/deadline inputs and never start validation callbacks before capacity acquisition.
Do not change validation command inventories, timeouts, root full-suite budgets, evidence bindings, or read-only commands.
Display bounded progress with holder story/command, pid/host where available, and heartbeat age.
Release safely after success or throw and reclaim only provably stale/dead holders.
Document that bare npm test is outside the lease and must not run concurrently with official validation.
